description: Source code for CLI commands related to Verifiable Credential (VC) verification in the AgentField project, including functions for parsing VC files, resolving DIDs, and outputting verification results.

methods.name: NewVCCommand
methods.description: Creates the main 'vc' command with subcommands for VC operations.

methods.name: NewVCVerifyCommand
methods.description: Creates the 'verify' subcommand for verifying a VC file.

methods.name: verifyVC
methods.description: Performs the verification process on a VC file, including parsing, DID resolution, and comprehensive verification.

methods.name: collectUniqueDIDs
methods.description: Extracts unique DIDs from the VC chain for resolution.

methods.name: resolveDID
methods.description: Resolves a DID using various methods based on flags and bundle.

methods.name: resolveWebDID
methods.description: Resolves a did:web DID by fetching the DID document from the web.

methods.name: resolveFromWeb
methods.description: Resolves a DID via web or local methods.

methods.name: resolveFromCustom
methods.description: Resolves a DID using a custom resolver URL.

methods.name: extractPublicKeyFromDIDDoc
methods.description: Extracts the public key in JWK format from a DID document.

methods.name: verifyVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies a VC's cryptographic signature (reserved for future use).

methods.name: verifyWorkflowVCSignature
methods.description: Verifies a workflow VC's cryptographic signature (reserved for future use).

methods.name: getDIDMethod
methods.description: Extracts the method part from a DID string.

methods.name: convertLegacyChain
methods.description: Converts legacy VC chain format to enhanced format.

methods.name: normalizeEnhancedChain
methods.description: Normalizes the enhanced VC chain structure for consistency.

methods.name: outputResult
methods.description: Outputs the verification result in specified format.

methods.name: outputPretty
methods.description: Outputs the result in a human-readable pretty format.
